gpu.tier: Secure Cloud advertised starting rate, not reserved quote
hours_meaning: scheduled test windows incl. assumed warm-up allowance
gpu.note: Hardware pricing only. Benchmark required before assuming one GPU can serve the complete selected local-model stack in real time.
